payload.name: Slipa
payload.description: 将屏幕录制转成演示视频
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Slipa turns a rough screen recording into a finished demo video. It transcribes what you said, rewrites it as a clean script, re-voices it with a narrator in any of twenty-nine languages, and renders the result with your logo, brand colours and captions. The narration language is independent of the recording language, so you can record once and publish in another. Ask for a video and Slipa tells you what it will cost before it spends anything.
payload.longDescription: Slipa 可将粗略的屏幕录制转换为完成度高的演示视频。它会转写你说的话，将其改写为流畅脚本，由旁白以二十九种语言中的任一种重新配音，并为成片添加你的标志、品牌颜色和字幕。旁白语言与录制语言互不依赖，因此你可以录制一次，再用另一种语言发布。请求生成视频时，Slipa 会先告知费用，然后才会产生任何支出。

payload.name: Postify
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Postify is a social media scheduling tool for teams: one calendar for the accounts you publish to, with drafts, scheduling, and delivery analytics in one place. The Postify plugin lets ChatGPT work that calendar with you: list posts and open a specific one, see which channels are connected, draft a new post, move a scheduled post to a different time, search your media library for an image you already uploaded, ask for a suggested posting time, publish a post immediately, or delete one. It can also pull performance figures for posts already delivered, and search Postify's own documentation when you need to know how something works.

Access runs through OAuth 2.1 with PKCE, and issued tokens are bound to the Postify MCP endpoint. You choose scopes on the consent screen, and a tool whose scope you did not grant is never registered for the session, so the assistant cannot see it. Connected apps are listed in Settings and can be revoked there, and every tool call is written to an audit log you can read in the app.

The two irreversible actions — publishing and deleting — are deliberately gated twice. First, an organization setting controls whether an AI assistant may perform them at all, and that setting can only be turned on by a person inside Postify; no AI credential carries the scope needed to enable it. Second, with the setting on, the first call returns a confirmation request with a short-lived token bound to the exact arguments, which must be echoed back on a second call before anything is published or deleted. Expect that first response — it is the safety step working, not an error.
payload.longDescription:
Postify 是面向团队的社交媒体排程工具：通过一个日历管理您发布内容的账户，并在一处管理草稿、排期和发布分析。Postify 插件让 ChatGPT 与您共同管理该日历：列出帖子并打开特定帖子、查看已连接的渠道、起草新帖子、将已排期帖子改到其他时间、在媒体库中搜索已上传的图片、询问建议的发布时间、立即发布帖子或删除帖子。它还可以提取已发布帖子的效果数据，并在您想了解某项功能时搜索 Postify 自有文档。

访问通过 OAuth 2.1 和 PKCE 实现，颁发的令牌绑定到 Postify MCP 端点。您可以在授权页面选择权限范围；未获授权的工具不会注册到会话中，因此助手无法看到它。已连接应用会列在“设置”中，您可在那里撤销连接；每次工具调用都会写入审计日志，您可以在应用中查阅。

两项不可撤销的操作——发布和删除——特意设置了双重门控。首先，组织设置决定 AI 助手是否可以执行这些操作，且只有 Postify 内的人员可以启用该设置；任何 AI 凭证都不具备启用它所需的权限范围。其次，启用后，首次调用会返回确认请求及一个短时有效、绑定到确切参数的令牌；必须在第二次调用中原样回传该令牌，才会执行发布或删除。首次响应是安全机制正常工作的表现，并非错误。

payload.name: Optmyzr
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Optmyzr helps advertisers and agencies inspect linked ad-account performance, opportunities, analytics, alerts, and workspace data; find product guidance; create monitoring routines; and prepare or apply reviewable keyword and negative-keyword changes from ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Optmyzr 帮助广告主和代理机构查看已关联广告账户的表现、机会、分析数据、提醒和工作区数据；查找产品指导；创建监控例程；并通过 ChatGPT 准备或应用可审核的关键词和否定关键词更改。

payload.name: Billy Grace Insights
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Billy Grace Insights lets marketers ask questions about their own campaign performance in plain language. Users can look up which accounts they have access to, discover the metrics, dimensions, and conversion events available for a dataset, and then fetch aggregated marketing, shopping, or keyword performance rows for a date range. Results can be broken down by dimensions such as channel, campaign, or product, and can be recalculated under different attribution models, attribution windows, and lookback windows so users can compare how each model reports the same period. The app only reads data the signed-in user is already authorised to see.
payload.longDescription: Billy Grace Insights 让营销人员用日常语言询问自己的广告活动表现。用户可以查找自己有权访问的账户，了解某个数据集可用的指标、维度和转化事件，然后获取指定日期范围内汇总的营销、购物或关键词表现数据行。结果可按渠道、广告活动或产品等维度细分，并可在不同归因模型、归因窗口和回溯窗口下重新计算，让用户比较各模型如何报告同一时期的数据。应用仅读取已登录用户已经获准查看的数据。

payload.name: Unify
payload.description: 发现、丰富并编排潜在客户
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect Unify to ChatGPT and Codex to run your outbound end to end: build target lists, enrich contacts with verified emails and phone numbers, draft personalized sequences, and sync it all back to your CRM. Then ask what's working: reply rates by sequence, rep activity, and conversion.

Try asking "Find champions from my customer accounts who recently started new roles, get their verified emails and mobile numbers, and draft a sequence," or "Show me the breakdown of tasks completed by reps over the last 30 days."

Unify searches 1.1B+ people and 65M+ companies across 40+ data providers. Find, enrich, and sequence prospects in one chat.
payload.longDescription:
将 Unify 连接到 ChatGPT 和 Codex，端到端开展外联工作：建立目标名单、补充经过验证的电子邮件地址和电话号码、起草个性化触达序列，并将所有内容同步回 CRM。之后还可以询问哪些做法有效：各序列的回复率、销售代表的活动情况和转化表现。

可以尝试提问：“找出我的客户账户中最近转任新职位的关键联系人，获取他们经过验证的电子邮件地址和手机号码，并起草一组触达消息”；或者“显示销售代表过去 30 days 完成任务的明细”。

Unify 可搜索 1.1B+ 位人士和 65M+ 家公司，数据覆盖 40+ 个提供商。在一次聊天中发现、补充潜在客户信息并编排触达序列。

payload.name: GoCodes
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: This plugin allows you to harness the power of AI while working with your GoCodes Asset & Inventory data. Now you can use AI chat to answer questions like 'Where's my nearest compressor?', 'What tasks do I need to work on today?' and much more. On your smartphone you can now talk to GoCodes using just your voice ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: 此插件可让你在使用 GoCodes 资产和库存数据时借助 AI。现在，你可以通过 AI 聊天询问“离我最近的压缩机在哪里？”、“我今天需要处理哪些任务？”等问题。在智能手机上，你还可以直接用语音通过 ChatGPT 与 GoCodes 对话。

payload.name: Whatalo
payload.description: 管理你的 Whatalo 商店
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Whatalo connects ChatGPT to a merchant's store so users can review store information, products, categories, inventory, customers, and orders. It also supports controlled catalog updates, inventory adjustments, product image uploads, and order status changes through the merchant's authorized Whatalo account.
payload.longDescription: Whatalo 将 ChatGPT 连接到商家的商店，让用户查看商店信息、商品、类别、库存、客户和订单。它还支持通过商家授权的 Whatalo 账户，以受控方式更新目录、调整库存、上传商品图片和更改订单状态。

payload.name: Laurel
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Laurel is the AI timekeeping and work intelligence platform built for professional services firms. This plugin brings that work into ChatGPT, so knowledge workers can review their day without leaving the conversation. Retrieve the time entries and activities Laurel captured throughout the day, and see where billable time went. Summarize work by client, matter, or application, and spot the gaps between what got done and what's been recorded. Turn that activity into billing narratives, ready for an end-of-day or weekly review. Access stays tied to your Laurel account throughout.
payload.longDescription: Laurel 是面向专业服务公司的 AI 工时记录与工作洞察平台。该插件将工作带入 ChatGPT，让知识工作者无需离开对话即可回顾一天的工作。检索 Laurel 全天记录的工时条目和活动，了解计费工时的去向。按客户、事项或应用汇总工作，并找出已完成工作与记录内容之间的差距。将活动转化为账单说明，方便在日末或每周回顾时使用。访问权限始终与你的 Laurel 账户绑定。

payload.name: Everlaw
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Everlaw provides a secure, standardized Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that allows OpenAI to connect to Everlaw and work with live matter data on behalf of an authenticated user.

Through the connector, a connected agent can understand a user’s Everlaw project structure, translate natural-language requests into Everlaw search logic, retrieve responsive documents and document text, and analyze metadata and Bates driven result sets. The connected agent can also support natural-language reporting and analysis workflows, while Everlaw remains the governed evidence layer and system of record for case materials, metadata, and work product.

Access to Deep Dive via this connector complements search and retrieval tools, as well as Everlaw’s native Deep Dive experience. It is intended to support broader, semantic, evidence-backed questions while preserving Everlaw’s permissions and the integrity of the underlying matter record.

The connector is designed to operate within the user’s existing Everlaw permission level. Every request is authenticated and authorized against the user’s Everlaw permissions, so the agent can access only the projects, documents, and data that user is already permitted to view. Deep Dive will also be available through the connector, allowing a user to query Deep Dive over eligible Everlaw project data and retrieve evidence-backed results without changing the underlying matter record.

Using the connector, an agent can:

Use Deep Dive to ask broader investigative questions and return evidence-backed results, once the Deep Dive tools are available.

Convert a natural-language request into a structured Everlaw search. 

Generate structured reports about project contents, document volumes, custodians, dates, Bates ranges, and other returned data. 

Search by document text, metadata, Bates or Control number, binder, coding, redactions, productions, processing criteria, and other supported terms. 

Identify the metadata fields, datasets, and processed uploads available in a project. 

Retrieve matching documents with Bates numbers, metadata, review links, document-text links, and extracted values. 

Summarize and analyze retrieved documents or result sets in natural language.

payload.name: Noah
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Noah Predict helps users investigate public signals, assess risk and trends, commission durable research, retrieve evidence-backed results, continue an investigation, and create client-ready research artifacts.
payload.longDescription: Noah Predict 帮助用户调查公开信号、评估风险和趋势、委托持久化研究、获取有证据支持的结果、继续调查，并创建面向客户的研究成果。

payload.name: BITZER Gascooler Tool
payload.description: 评估并选择气体冷却器
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: BITZER Gascooler Tool rates released R744 gas-cooler models, selects models for a required capacity, retrieves validated R744 saturation limits, and creates localized PDF, STEP, 3D, dimensional-drawing, pinch-diagram, and capacity-map artifacts in SI units. Compatible ChatGPT clients receive one inline multilingual result gallery with calculation inputs and outputs, PNG previews, an interactive 3D model, warnings, the mandatory tentative-data notice, expiry status, and secure temporary downloads. The app never substitutes estimated engineering values when calculation data, traces, released geometry, or rendering dependencies are unavailable.
payload.longDescription: BITZER Gascooler Tool对已发布的R744气体冷却器型号进行性能评估，为所需容量选择型号，检索经过验证的R744饱和界限，并以SI单位生成本地化的PDF、STEP、3D、尺寸图、夹点图和容量图文件。兼容的ChatGPT客户端会收到一个内嵌的多语言结果展示区，其中包含计算输入和输出、PNG预览、交互式3D模型、警告、必须展示的暂定数据说明、到期状态和安全的临时下载。当计算数据、计算追踪记录、已发布的几何模型或渲染依赖不可用时，应用绝不会用估算的工程数值替代。

payload.name: Patlytics
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Patlytics brings concept-level, AI-native patent search into your assistant: semantic, not keyword-based. Describe an invention in plain prose and get the most relevant patents, look up any patent's claims, search the scientific literature, and pull your own organization's saved patents, all through structured, predictable tools (not a black box).


The five tools are read-only: semantic patent search (optionally anchored to a reference patent), patent lookup (bibliographic data and full claims), non-patent literature search (via OpenAlex), and listings of your organization's private portfolios and vault. Search is semantic, so a richer description (how an invention works, the problem it solves, its components) returns better results.


Access is for existing Patlytics users: each member signs in with their own account (OAuth), and results are scoped to their organization. Deeper work like freedom-to-operate opinions, infringement and invalidity claim charts, and patent drafting runs in the Patlytics web app, linked from every result.
payload.longDescription:
Patlytics将概念级AI原生专利检索引入您的助手：基于语义而非关键词。用通俗易懂的描述说明一项发明，即可获得最相关的专利，查阅任意专利的权项，搜索科学文献，并调取贵司保存的专利，所有操作均通过结构化可预测的工具完成（而非黑箱）

五个工具均为只读模式：语义专利检索（可关联参考专利）、专利查询（包含著录数据和完整权项）、非专利文献检索（通过OpenAlex）、以及贵司私有专利组合和保险库清单。语义搜索特性意味着更详细的描述（发明原理、解决的问题、组成部分）将获得更精准的结果

现有Patlytics用户可访问：每位成员需使用个人账户登录（OAuth），结果范围限定于其所属组织。深度工作如自由实施意见、侵权无效比对表、专利撰写等需在Patlytics网页应用中完成，所有结果页均提供链接入口

payload.name: Goodword
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Businesses run on relationships. Your next deal, hire, client, or introduction starts with someone already in your network.

Goodword brings together your LinkedIn network, email and calendar history, and the private context behind each relationship, so ChatGPT can help you find the right people, understand why they matter, and act at the right moment.

Search your direct and extended network, pull enriched profiles and relationship history, and find warm paths to people you want to reach. Turn meeting debriefs into notes, reminders, and follow-ups. Manage introductions and groups, and see who you should reconnect with next.

A CRM manages contacts. LinkedIn gives you connections. Goodword helps you use the relationships you’ve already built to find clients, make key hires, raise capital, and get the introductions that move your business forward.

Requires a Goodword account. Access is scoped to your network through OAuth.
payload.longDescription:
商业建立在关系之上。下一笔交易、下一位员工、客户或引荐，往往始于你现有人脉中的某个人。

Goodword 汇总你的 LinkedIn 人脉、邮件和日历记录，以及每段关系背后的私人背景，让 ChatGPT 帮你找到合适的人、理解他们的重要性，并在恰当时机采取行动。

搜索直接和扩展人脉，获取丰富的个人资料与关系历史，找到联系目标人物的暖介绍路径。把会议复盘变成笔记、提醒和跟进。管理引荐和群组，查看下一步该与谁重新联系。

CRM 管理联系人，LinkedIn 提供连接；Goodword 帮你利用已经建立的关系寻找客户、招募关键人才、筹集资金，并获得推动业务发展的引荐。

需要 Goodword 账户。通过 OAuth 将访问范围限定在你的人脉网络内。

payload.name: Harvey
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: The Harvey plugin connects ChatGPT to Harvey's AI-powered legal intelligence platform. It supports three core capabilities: (1) General legal inquiries grounded in Harvey's legal knowledge; (2) Analysis and search over your firm's Vault projects — saved work product, memos, and prior documents; (3) Targeted research using specialized knowledge sources, such as UK Tax legislation and HMRC manuals. Discovery tools let users list available Vault projects and knowledge sources. All tools are read-only and operate strictly within the authenticated user's Harvey permissions. Access requires a Harvey account with an active license and the MCP feature enabled by your workspace admin.
payload.longDescription: Harvey 插件将 ChatGPT 连接到 Harvey 的 AI 法律智能平台，支持三项核心能力：(1) 基于 Harvey 法律知识的常规法律咨询；(2) 搜索和分析你所在律所 Vault 项目中的已保存工作成果、备忘录和历史文件；(3) 使用英国税法和 HMRC 手册等专业知识源开展定向研究。发现工具可列出可用 Vault 项目和知识源。所有工具均为只读，并严格遵循已认证用户的 Harvey 权限。需要 Harvey 账户、有效许可，以及工作区管理员启用 MCP 功能。

payload.name: Salesforce
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Reimagine your sales workflow with Salesforce and ChatGPT. Get CRM context on every deal directly in ChatGPT, so reps can research, plan, and close faster. Then, enrich Salesforce with the key insights so you and your team can make smarter decisions.

From pipeline updates to account research, it gives you the clarity, speed, and guidance you need to close more deals with confidence.
payload.longDescription:
与 Salesforce 和 ChatGPT 一起重新构想你的销售工作流。直接在 ChatGPT 中获取每笔交易的 CRM 背景信息，帮助销售代表更快地调研、规划并成交。然后将关键洞察补充到 Salesforce 中，让你和团队做出更明智的决策。

从销售渠道更新到客户账户调研，它都能提供所需的清晰信息、速度和指导，帮助你更有把握地赢得更多交易。

payload.name: ChatGPT Admin
payload.description: 为工作空间所有者或管理员管理 ChatGPT 工作空间。
payload.summaryOriginal: Manage ChatGPT workspaces for workspace owners or admins.
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Manage workspace members, groups, roles, billing, usage limits, and increase requests; analyze workspace and Codex usage. Supports credit-based and native USD workspaces: read balance_unit, use explicitly tagged USD amount inputs, and never convert credits into native USD. Actions respect the signed-in user's workspace permissions.
payload.longDescription: 管理工作空间成员、群组、角色、账单、使用限额和额度增加申请；分析工作空间及 Codex 使用情况。支持按额度计费和原生 USD 工作空间：读取 balance_unit，使用明确标记为 USD 的金额输入，绝不要将额度换算为原生 USD。所有操作均遵循已登录用户的工作空间权限。

payload.name: Page Pulse
payload.description: 跟踪搜索引擎优化和页面变更
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Page Pulse combines Google Search Console data, Google Analytics 4 data, and on-page change tracking for the user's own websites. Through ChatGPT, users can list their tracked projects, investigate traffic drops by comparing analytics periods, see exactly what changed on their pages (content, titles, meta descriptions, links) and when, analyze the search queries driving traffic, start tracking new sites or hand-picked page lists, and set up email or Slack alerts for meaningful page changes or traffic thresholds.
payload.longDescription: Page Pulse整合了用户自有网站的Google Search Console数据、Google Analytics 4数据以及页面变更追踪功能。通过ChatGPT，用户可列出已追踪项目、通过对比分析周期调查流量下降原因、精确查看页面内容/标题/元描述/链接等具体变更内容及时间、分析引流搜索关键词、新增网站或自选页面清单的追踪功能，并为关键页面变更或流量阈值设置邮件或Slack警报。

payload.name: Enterpret
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Enterpret helps teams understand what customers are saying across support tickets, sales calls, app reviews, surveys, Slack, and more. Ask natural-language questions to find complaint trends, feature requests, segment-specific patterns, and direct customer quotes. Results are grounded in your customer context graph and include links back to source records so product, GTM, and leadership teams can act with context.
payload.longDescription: Enterpret 帮助团队了解客户在支持工单、销售电话、应用评价、调查、Slack 等渠道中的反馈。你可以用自然语言提问，查找投诉趋势、功能需求、特定客群模式和客户原话。结果以客户上下文图谱为依据，并附有指向源记录的链接，让产品、GTM 和管理团队能结合背景采取行动。

payload.name: ZipRecruiter
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Find live jobs on ZipRecruiter without leaving ChatGPT. Search by job title, company, or location, then narrow results by salary, distance, remote or hybrid work, employment type, and date posted. After reviewing a listing, jump to ZipRecruiter to apply. Example: “@ziprecruiter find me customer service jobs in Los Angeles that pay at least $24 an hour"
payload.longDescription: 无需离开 ChatGPT，即可查找 ZipRecruiter 上的实时职位。按职位名称、公司或地点搜索，再按薪资、距离、远程或混合办公、雇佣类型和发布日期缩小结果范围。查看职位信息后，可跳转到 ZipRecruiter 申请。示例：“@ziprecruiter 找洛杉矶的客服工作，时薪至少 $24”

payload.name: Controlle
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
O Controlle é uma plataforma de gestão financeira para pequenas e médias empresas brasileiras, com foco no setor de serviços.

Com este plugin, você acessa o financeiro da sua empresa direto na conversa. Consulte saldo por conta, contas a pagar e a receber por período, lançamentos por categoria e a projeção de fluxo de caixa. Também é possível registrar novos lançamentos e atualizar informações, sempre com confirmação antes de gravar.

Exemplos de uso: "quanto tenho a pagar essa semana?", "como ficou meu fluxo de caixa em julho?", "quais clientes estão em atraso?", "lance uma despesa de energia de R$ 1.200 com vencimento dia 15".

É necessário ter uma conta ativa no Controlle. No primeiro uso, você conecta sua conta e autoriza o acesso.
payload.longDescription:
Controlle 是面向巴西中小企业、重点服务行业的财务管理平台。

通过插件可在对话中查询账户余额、按期间查看应付和应收账款、按类别查看记录以及现金流预测，也可登记和更新记录，写入前始终需要确认。

示例：“我这周要付多少钱？”、“7 月现金流怎么样？”、“哪些客户逾期？”、“登记一笔 R$ 1.200 的电费，15 日到期。”

需要有效的 Controlle 账户。首次使用时需连接账户并授权访问。

payload.name: Magister Marketing
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Magister Marketing connects your brand's marketing workspace to ChatGPT. Review your brand profile and marketing plan, then work the plan item by item: read the next prioritized task with its full brief, record progress notes, and update item status as work ships.

Track AI visibility and GEO. See how ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews answer the prompts your buyers actually ask about your category, start new scoring rounds, and open an interactive report showing score trends across rounds, results by AI model, and per-prompt detail.

Run SEO and answer-engine audits with per-channel health scores, research keywords with search volume and difficulty, and review Google Ads, Meta Ads, and TikTok Ads performance. Draft and schedule social posts from your brand voice, pull per-post and follower analytics, discover influencers by channel and topic, work with project assets and files, monitor public sources for brand mentions, and open pull requests against a connected GitHub repository.

Writes are scoped and audited. Publishing a post, sending an email, merging a pull request, and deleting a file each stop at an explicit confirmation or a server-side approval that a person must grant in the Magister app before anything happens. New ad campaigns are created paused on Meta or TikTok, and this connector has no way to activate a campaign or begin ad spend. Requires a Magister account.
payload.longDescription:
Magister Marketing 将品牌营销工作区连接到 ChatGPT。查看品牌资料和营销计划，然后逐项执行计划：读取下一项优先任务及完整简报，记录进展笔记，并在工作完成时更新项目状态。

追踪 AI 可见度和 GEO。查看 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini、Perplexity 和 Google AI Overviews 如何回答买家对你所在品类实际提出的问题，开始新一轮评分，并打开交互式报告，查看各轮评分趋势、各 AI 模型结果和每个提示词的详情。

运行 SEO 和答案引擎审计，查看各渠道健康评分；研究带搜索量和难度的关键词；审查 Google Ads、Meta Ads 和 TikTok Ads 表现。以品牌声音起草并安排社交帖子，获取每条帖子和粉丝分析，按渠道和主题发现影响者，使用项目资产和文件，监测公开来源中的品牌提及，并针对已连接的 GitHub 仓库创建拉取请求。

所有写入操作都受范围限制并经过审计。发布帖子、发送邮件、合并拉取请求和删除文件，都会在实际发生前停留在明确确认步骤，或等待人工在 Magister 应用中授予服务器端批准。Meta 或 TikTok 上创建的新广告活动会以暂停状态创建，此连接器无法启用活动或开始广告支出。需要 Magister 账户。

payload.name: MCLogs
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: MCLogs lets users look up public maritime shipment tracking information by container number or Bill of Lading. It returns the current status, route, estimated dates, vessel and voyage details, Telex Release status, and available event history. This version does not provide invoice access and does not require an MCLogs account or authentication.
payload.longDescription: MCLogs 可让用户通过集装箱编号或提单查询公开的海运货物追踪信息。它会返回当前状态、路线、预计日期、船舶和航次详情、电放状态以及可用的事件历史记录。此版本不提供发票访问权限，也无需 MCLogs 账户或身份验证。

payload.name: PredictLeads
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Give your AI assistant structured intelligence on millions of companies worldwide. Data sourced directly from company websites, career pages, news outlets, SEC filings, and review sites. Continuously refreshed, with 5+ years of history.

Every API endpoint is a native tool: ask natural-language questions, get structured answers.

- Enrich known companies by domain name: news, job postings, technographics, key customers, lookalikes.
- Discover net new companies by criteria: technologies used, hiring activity, funding received and more. Filtered by location, size, and industry.

Signal types: News Events (launches, partnerships, leadership changes...), Job Openings (with salaries, seniority, locations), Technology Detections, Financing Events, Similar Companies, SEC Filings (as Markdown), Product offerings, Key Customers, and GitHub Activity.

Built for GTM teams, researchers, and investors running agentic workflows that need live, structured company data.

payload.name: Motion
payload.description: 分析 Meta 创意广告
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Motion connects OpenAI to your creative analytics workspace. Analyze ad creative performance across Meta campaigns — surface top performers, spot declining creatives, and understand what's working and why. Research competitor ad libraries for trends and inspiration. Access demographic breakdowns, creative transcripts, and performance reports. Motion helps marketers make faster, data-driven decisions about what to create next.
payload.longDescription: Motion 将 OpenAI 连接到你的创意分析工作区。分析 Meta 广告系列中的广告创意表现，找出高绩效创意、发现表现下滑的创意，并了解哪些内容有效以及原因。研究竞争对手广告库以获取趋势和灵感。访问人口统计细分、创意转录和绩效报告。Motion 帮助营销人员更快地以数据为依据决定下一步创作。

payload.name: Litera
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Litera's Lito plugin brings your firm's collective knowledge and experience into ChatGPT. Ask questions in plain English and get cited answers drawn from your firm's experience data, without leaving the conversation.

- Natural language search: ask questions like "Show me M&A deals for banking clients in Japan" and get results with entity links across matters, clients, people and experience records.
- Tabular results: view paged, sortable tables from any search to quickly scan and compare results.
- Matter profiles: pull up full matter details by drilling into a specific matter from your search results.
- Client profiles: retrieve complete client profiles to understand relationship history and related experience.
- People profiles: look up individuals to find their expertise, matter history and firm roles.
- Marketing packet profiles: access full experience packets to support pitches, proposals and RFPs.
- Conversational refinement: chain any of the above together with follow-up questions to narrow down exactly what you need.

All answers include citations and respect firm security permissions, ethical walls, and user entitlements, so professionals only see what they are authorised to access. Litera’s Lito helps lawyers and business professionals tap into firm knowledge with deterministic accuracy, Raising The Bar™ on a process that would otherwise require navigating multiple systems or relying on institutional memory.
payload.longDescription:
Litera的Lito插件将您公司的集体知识和经验带入ChatGPT。用自然语言提问，即可获得引用公司经验数据的权威答案，无需离开对话界面。

- 自然语言搜索：以「显示日本银行客户的企业并购交易」等自然语言提问，即可获得包含跨案件、客户、人员和经验记录的实体链接结果。
- 表格结果：从任何搜索中查看分页可排序的表格，快速浏览和对比结果。
- 案件档案：通过搜索结果中特定案件深入查看完整案件详情。
- 客户档案：获取完整客户档案，了解关系历史和相关经验。
- 人员档案：查询个人资料，查找专业领域、案件历史和律所职位。
- 市场推广资料包：访问完整经验资料包，支持路演演示、提案和投标文件。
- 对话式精炼：通过后续问题将上述功能串联，精准定位所需信息。

所有回答均包含引用来源，并遵循公司安全权限、伦理防火墙和用户权限设置，确保专业人士仅能看到其授权访问的内容。Litera的Lito通过确定性精准度，帮助律师和商业专业人士调用律所知识，以提升标准™重新定义原本需要穿梭多个系统或依赖机构记忆的流程。

payload.name: Pazarus
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Pazarus, Trendyol, Hepsiburada, Amazon, n11, Çiçeksepeti, PttAVM, Pazarama, İdefix ve e-ticaret sitelerinizi tek panelde yöneten pazaryeri entegrasyon platformudur. Bu plugin Pazarus hesabınızı ChatGPT'ye bağlar; mağaza verilerinizi sohbet içinde sorgulayıp analiz edersiniz.

Neler yapabilirsiniz:
• Satış: "Dünkü satışlarımı pazaryerine göre analiz et", "Bu hafta en çok satan ürünlerim"
• Sipariş: "Dün gelen siparişlerin kaçı kargolandı?", "TY-100234 numaralı sipariş hangi durumda?"
• İade: "Son 30 günde iade oranım ve en sık iade sebepleri"
• Stok: "Stoğu biten ürünler", "14 gün içinde tükenecek ürünler"
• Müşteri soruları: "Cevap bekleyen pazaryeri soruları"
• Kâr: "Bu ayki kâr-zarar özetim, komisyon ve kargo payı"
• Durum: "Pazaryeri bağlantılarımda sorun var mı, son gönderim hataları neler?"

Yanıtlar gerçek mağaza verinizden gelir ve ilgili panel sayfasına bağlantı içerir. Bağlantı OAuth ile kurulur, yalnızca Pazarus panelinde yetkili olduğunuz verileri kapsar, müşteri kişisel bilgileri maskelenir ve tüm araçlar salt okunurdur (stok, fiyat veya sipariş değiştirmez). Bağlantıyı panelden istediğiniz an kesebilirsiniz. Pazarus hesabı gerekir; ücretsiz plan dahil tüm planlarda kullanılabilir.
payload.longDescription:
Pazarus 是一个电商平台集成服务，可在一个面板中管理 Trendyol、Hepsiburada、Amazon、n11、Çiçeksepeti、PttAVM、Pazarama、İdefix 及其他电商网站。此插件会将你的 Pazarus 账户连接到 ChatGPT；你可以在聊天中查询并分析店铺数据。

可以执行的操作：
• 销售：“按平台分析我昨天的销售额”“本周我卖得最好的商品”
• 订单：“昨天收到的订单有多少已发货？”“订单 TY-100234 目前是什么状态？”
• 退货：“最近 30 天的退货率和最常见的退货原因”
• 库存：“缺货商品”“14 天内即将售罄的商品”
• 客户问题：“等待回复的平台客户问题”
• 利润：“本月损益摘要、佣金和运费占比”
• 状态：“我的平台连接有问题吗？最近有哪些提交错误？”

回答来自真实店铺数据，并附有相关面板页面的链接。连接通过 OAuth 建立，仅涵盖你在 Pazarus 面板有权限访问的数据；客户个人信息会被遮蔽；所有工具均为只读（不会更改库存、价格或订单）。你可以随时在面板中断开连接。需要 Pazarus 账户；所有套餐均可使用，包括免费套餐。

payload.name: Minerva
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Minerva helps marketing teams find and understand audiences, enrich selected person records, and prepare audience activations. Search Minerva’s US person data or your organization’s connected customer data, inspect audience previews and person details, explore customer analytics and personas, calculate lookalike scores, and save audiences from the highest-scoring people. Review connected destinations and billing usage, then export selected audiences to CSV or deliver them through supported integrations. A Minerva account is required; first-party search, analytics, personas, scoring, and destination availability depend on your organization’s setup. Some enrichment and audience-delivery actions consume plan allowance and may incur charges under your existing contract.
payload.longDescription: Minerva 帮助营销团队寻找并了解受众、丰富选定的人员记录并准备受众激活。搜索 Minerva 的美国人员数据或组织已连接的客户数据，查看受众预览和人员详情，探索客户分析与画像，计算相似受众分数，并保存得分最高人员组成的受众。查看已连接的目标和计费用量，然后将选定受众导出为 CSV，或通过支持的集成交付。需要 Minerva 账户；第一方搜索、分析、画像、评分和目标可用性取决于组织设置。部分丰富和受众交付操作会消耗套餐额度，并可能依据现有合同产生费用。

payload.name: Maxed Marketing
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Maxed Marketing helps teams explore authorized marketing, AI-visibility, and—where permitted—product-telemetry data to investigate performance and identify next steps.
payload.longDescription: Maxed Marketing 帮助团队探索获授权的营销、AI 可见度以及在允许情况下的产品遥测数据，以调查表现并确定下一步。

payload.name: Canarics
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Canarics runs AI voice agents that answer and make phone calls for sales and service teams, and analyzes every recorded human call (summary, quality score, sentiment, next steps). This connector lets a team's AI assistant read minute usage, voice agents, call summaries, AI-agent conversations and daily statistics, check history with a specific caller, and request an AI callback to customers the team already knows. Companies without an account can sign up through the assistant: signup produces a claim link where a real person verifies their phone by SMS and accepts the terms, then a trial activates with a demo voice agent generated from the company website. EU-hosted (Google Cloud Run, europe-central2). Read-only by design where it matters: no transcripts, no voice-agent prompt editing, no cold-call capability.
payload.longDescription: Canarics 为销售和服务团队运行 AI 语音智能体，负责接听和拨打电话，并分析每通录音的真人通话（摘要、质量评分、情绪、后续步骤）。此连接器允许团队的 AI 助手读取分钟用量、语音智能体、通话摘要、AI 智能体对话和每日统计数据，查看与特定来电者的历史记录，并请求回拨团队已认识的客户。尚无账户的公司可以通过助手注册：注册后会生成一个认领链接，由真人通过短信验证手机并接受条款，之后即可启用试用，并根据公司网站生成演示语音智能体。托管于欧盟（Google Cloud Run，europe-central2）。关键功能按设计为只读：不提供通话转录文本、语音智能体提示词编辑或陌生电话外呼能力。

payload.name: SmartFlow
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: SmartFlow Portal brings client projects into ChatGPT. View project plans and milestones, follow actions waiting on you, review invoices, and keep delivery moving. Authorized SmartFlow administrators can also manage organizations, plans, client submissions, time entries, and billing workflows, with access enforced from the signed-in user's role and organization scope.
payload.longDescription: SmartFlow门户将客户项目带入ChatGPT。查看项目计划和关键节点，跟踪等待您的操作，审核发票并推动交付进程。授权的SmartFlow管理员还可管理组织架构、计划方案、客户提交内容、工时记录和计费工作流程，访问权限由已登录用户的角色和组织范围强制执行。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Read project boards and plans, Track and submit client tasks, Manage clients and their teams, Build projects, stages and tasks, Upload documents, request signatures, Draft, publish and send invoices, Download invoice PDFs and document files, Set up recurring billing, Schedule meetings, Read and send messages, Search conversations and discuss board items, Publish announcements, Handle client requests, Log time, Review workspace settings and integrations, Triage leads and outbound prospects, Watch client activity

payload.name: Made In Show
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Made In Show (MIS) is the management platform for event production companies — audio, video and lighting service providers. This connector links ChatGPT to your company's MIS installation so your team can work with live production data in plain language.

Ask about productions and their schedules, check warehouse availability for specific dates, spot material and crew conflicts before they happen, review how complete a production is, and read production notes and supplier statistics — and, when your administrator allows it, act on the data: reserve equipment, add locations, create productions, and draft estimate texts.

Access is off by default and controlled per user by your MIS administrator: each user's AI access can view data, view and act, or nothing at all. Write operations follow the same per-user permission, enforced server-side on every call; tools designed for impactful changes (such as creating a production) add their own two-step confirmation. The connector authenticates with OAuth against your installation; data flows only between ChatGPT and your MIS backend, is never used for model training by Made In Show, and tool calls are logged for 90 days for audit purposes (responses are never stored).

Requires an account on a Made In Show installation with AI access enabled by the administrator.
payload.longDescription:
Made In Show (MIS) 是面向活动制作公司的管理平台，适用于音频、视频和灯光服务供应商。此连接器将 ChatGPT 连接到你公司的 MIS 安装环境，让团队能够用日常语言处理实时制作数据。

你可以询问制作项目及其日程、查看特定日期的仓库库存、提前发现物料和人员冲突、检查制作项目完成度，以及查看制作备注和供应商统计数据；如果管理员允许，还可以操作数据：预留设备、添加地点、创建制作项目和起草报价文字。

默认情况下访问权限处于关闭状态，由 MIS 管理员按用户控制：每个用户的 AI 访问权限可以是仅查看数据、查看并操作，或完全无权访问。写入操作遵循相同的用户权限，并在每次调用时由服务器端强制执行；对于创建制作项目等影响较大的操作，工具还会增加两步确认。连接器通过 OAuth 对接你的安装环境；数据只在 ChatGPT 与 MIS 后端之间流动，Made In Show 不会将其用于模型训练，并且工具调用会记录 90 天以供审计（不会存储响应内容）。

需要在已启用 AI 访问权限的 Made In Show 安装环境中拥有账户。

payload.name: Recruiterflow
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Recruiterflow helps users search and count candidates and jobs, resolve team members, companies, stages, and custom fields, inspect job pipelines, and review candidate activity timelines through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Recruiterflow 帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 搜索并统计候选人和职位、确定团队成员、公司、阶段和自定义字段、查看职位招聘流程，并检查候选人活动时间线。

payload.name: V7 Go (EU)
payload.description: 运行工作流并查询知识
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: V7 Go turns documents and unstructured data into structured, queryable information, right inside ChatGPT. Discover and configure workflows, run them over your documents to extract structured fields, search across your files, add documents to knowledge graphs, and query the resulting workflow and context graph data, so you get answers grounded in your own sources.
payload.longDescription: V7 Go 可在 ChatGPT 中将文档和非结构化数据转化为结构化、可查询的信息。你可以发现并配置工作流，在文档上运行工作流以提取结构化字段，搜索文件，将文档添加到知识图谱，并查询由此生成的工作流和上下文图数据，从而获得以你自己的资料为依据的答案。

payload.name: Onlinecomponents Search
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect ChatGPT to OnlineComponents Search to explore the complete electronic components catalog by manufacturer, part number, or keyword. Retrieve current stock levels, pricing and quantity breaks, packaging options, ordering requirements, and lifecycle status. Ideal for engineers and buyers who need to find parts, compare alternatives, and check availability directly within ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: 将 ChatGPT 连接到 OnlineComponents Search，按制造商、零件号或关键词探索完整的电子元件目录。获取当前库存水平、价格和数量阶梯、包装选项、订购要求及生命周期状态。适合需要在 ChatGPT 中寻找零件、比较替代品并检查供应情况的工程师和采购人员。

payload.name: SalesNow
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search and research company profiles, job postings, news, and other business information using SalesNow's company data. Use it to build sales prospect lists and prepare for customer meetings.
payload.longDescription: 使用 SalesNow 的公司数据搜索和研究公司简介、招聘信息、新闻及其他商业信息。利用这些信息建立销售潜在客户名单，并为客户会议做准备。

payload.name: Guest-Ready Score
payload.description: 评估您的房源准备情况
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Guest-Ready Score is a 12-question assessment that measures how ready a short-term rental is to welcome guests. It is designed for Airbnb hosts, short-term rental owners, vacation rental operators, and owners of cottages, cabins, lake houses, beach houses, chalets, condos, apartments, guest houses, lodges, villas, ski properties, waterfront rentals, country homes, tiny homes, furnished rentals and holiday rentals.

The assessment reviews twelve core areas of the guest stay: arrival and check-in, beds and sleeping comfort, bathrooms, kitchen readiness, lighting, temperature and climate comfort, Wi-Fi, cleanliness, restocking, guest communication, safety, and local information. It takes about two minutes and provides a Guest-Ready Score showing the areas already working well and the areas where attention will most improve the stay.

Use Guest-Ready Score to check whether a property is ready to list, prepare for a first guest, audit an existing rental, benchmark against hospitality standards, or find the areas most likely to lift guest reviews.

The standards come from The Guest Before The Rest by Valerie Balderson and Greg Hoover, drawn from seventeen years of furnished rental management in Ottawa, Canada.
payload.longDescription:
Guest-Ready Score是一项包含12个问题的评估测试，用于衡量短期租赁房源迎接客人的准备程度。该评估针对Airbnb房东、短期租赁业主、度假租赁运营商，以及木屋、小屋、湖畔房屋、海滩别墅、雪茄屋、公寓、客房、旅馆、别墅、滑雪房产、临水租赁房产、乡村住宅、微型住宅、带家具租赁房产和节日租赁房产的所有者。

该评估涵盖客人入住的十二个核心领域：到达与入住、床铺与睡眠舒适度、卫生间、厨房准备情况、照明、温度与气候舒适度、Wi-Fi、清洁度、补货情况、客人沟通、安全措施和本地信息。评估耗时约两分钟，会生成一个Guest-Ready评分，显示当前表现良好的方面以及最需要关注的改进领域。

使用Guest-Ready Score可检查房源是否已准备好上架、为首位客人做准备、审计现有租赁房产、与酒店业标准进行基准比较，或找出最可能提升客人评价的改进领域。

这些评估标准源自Valerie Balderson和Greg Hoover所著《客人永远先于一切》，其内容源于作者在加拿大渥太华长达十七年的家具齐全租赁管理经验。

payload.name: Tracxn MCP
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Tracxn MCP gives you access to the full Tracxn platform - companies, funding rounds, investors, M&A, cap tables, financials, and more - directly from your favorite AI assistant.

What you can do once connected:
- Search for companies by sector, geography, stage, or custom criteria
- Pull funding histories and investor profiles
- Track recent M&A, IPOs, and market activity
- Generate research reports grounded in real Tracxn data
payload.longDescription:
Tracxn MCP让您能够通过最喜爱的AI助手直接访问完整的Tracxn平台——包括公司信息、融资轮次、投资者、并购交易、资本结构表、财务数据等更多内容。

连接后可实现以下操作：
- 按行业、地区、发展阶段或自定义条件搜索公司
- 提取融资历史及投资者档案
- 跟踪最新并购交易、IPO及市场动态
- 基于真实Tracxn数据生成研究报告

payload.name: Clera
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Clera helps company hiring teams search vetted candidates against a role, review recommendations, request introductions, track hiring progress, and manage roles, public company profiles and private contacts. Search results mask candidate names but retain professional history; semantic search may send search inputs to Azure. Role-based searches show advisory fit flags that do not block introductions. Detailed profiles can remain available after an earlier named share expires or is revoked, and professional free text may contain personal details. Introduction requests can send emails and submit applications to a connected hiring system. Feedback is sent through Slack with user and company identity. Private call logs retain caller identity, inputs and results without automatic expiry.
payload.longDescription: Clera帮助公司招聘团队根据职位搜索经过筛选的候选人，查看推荐意见，请求介绍，跟踪招聘进度，并管理职位信息、公开公司资料及私人联系人。搜索结果会隐藏候选人姓名，但保留其专业经历；语义搜索可能将搜索内容发送至Azure。基于职位的搜索会显示咨询适配标志，但不会阻止介绍请求。详细资料在早期指定的分享过期或被撤销后仍可访问，专业领域的自由文本可能包含个人详情。介绍请求可发送邮件并提交申请至连接的招聘系统。反馈通过Slack发送，包含用户及公司身份信息。私人通话记录会保留通话者身份、输入内容及结果，且不会自动过期。

payload.name: Talentin AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Talentin helps recruiters and hiring teams work an entire sourcing pass inside ChatGPT: draft a job description from a rough hiring requirement, search the Talentin candidate database with a job description or plain-English brief, review compact candidate cards, open full work-history profiles, and run detailed match analyses that score one or several candidates against the role with requirement coverage, pros, cons, and a summary. Users can also paste a resume to get a recruiter-style fit analysis against a specific job description. Each user connects with their own Talentin API key, so all searches and analyses run against their own Talentin account and quota.
payload.longDescription: Talentin帮助招聘人员和招聘团队在ChatGPT内完成完整的招聘流程：根据初步招聘需求起草职位描述，通过职位描述或通俗易懂的简要说明搜索Talentin候选人数据库，查看简洁的候选人卡片，打开完整的工作经历档案，对一名或多名候选人进行详细匹配分析，根据需求覆盖情况、优缺点和总结进行评分。用户还可以粘贴简历，针对特定职位描述获得招聘人员风格的匹配分析。每位用户使用自己的Talentin API密钥，所有搜索和分析均在其个人Talentin账户和配额下执行。

payload.name: AdsAgent
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: AdsAgent helps advertising operators inspect Meta performance, manage reusable launch templates, prepare campaign changes, and execute explicitly confirmed Meta advertising actions through ChatGPT. OAuth connects to the operator's own AdsAgent workspace; advertising delivery changes require explicit confirmation, and workspace templates and settings can be edited directly at the user's request. AdsAgent never asks for health, payment-card, government-ID, or biometric data.
payload.longDescription: AdsAgent帮助广告运营人员检查Meta表现，管理可重复使用的启动模板，准备活动变更，并通过ChatGPT执行明确确认的Meta广告操作。OAuth连接至运营商自有的AdsAgent工作区；广告投放变更需要明确确认，工作区模板和设置可根据用户请求直接编辑。AdsAgent不会索取健康信息、支付卡、政府身份证或生物识别数据。

payload.name: Atlas
payload.description: 在聊天中发送和签署合同
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Atlas is your AI contract agent. Unlimited e-sign is free, with no credit card required.

Draft an agreement in the conversation, or share a PDF or DOCX, and Atlas turns it into a signable document: it detects signature lines, dates, and fields, and works out who signs what. You get a review link, click Send, and signers get a clean signing page on any device with no account needed.

Ask things like "send this MSA to sarah@acme.com for signature," "who still hasn't signed?", "remind them," or "pull the payment terms from the signed contract." Repeat sends run from saved templates in one message.

Atlas is review-first: it prepares everything and a human approves before any signature request goes out. Every signed document includes a completion certificate and a full audit trail.
payload.longDescription:
Atlas是您的AI合同代理。无限次电子签名免费，无需信用卡

在对话中起草协议，或分享PDF或DOCX文件，Atlas会将其转换为可签署的文档：它会检测签名行、日期和字段，并确定各方的签署内容。您将获得预览链接，点击发送后，签署人即可在任何设备上通过无需账户的简洁签署页面完成操作

可发送类似「将这份MSA发送至sarah@acme.com进行签署」、「还有谁未签署？」、「提醒他们」或「从已签署合同中提取付款条款」的指令。重复发送可通过一个消息中的已保存模板完成

Atlas采用审核优先策略：它会预先准备好所有内容，并在任何签名请求发出前由人工审核。每份已签署的文件均包含完成证书和完整的审计追踪记录

payload.name: ProfitTree
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: ProfitTree helps Etsy sellers research public listings, shops, and keywords and inspect their connected shops' sales, profit, orders, ads, product costs, and tracked items through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: ProfitTree通过ChatGPT帮助Etsy卖家研究公开列表、店铺和关键词，并查看其关联店铺的销售数据、利润、订单、广告、产品成本及跟踪商品。

payload.name: Metadata
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect your Metadata account to create editable, on-brand ad concepts, look up audience targeting criteria and estimate reach, inspect campaign setup, and analyze advertising performance and pipeline attribution. Work with campaign workflows for Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, Reddit, Google Ads, and Microsoft Advertising, subject to your connected accounts, permissions, and the available tools. Review proposed changes before authorizing campaign launches or changes to live budgets.

An existing Metadata account with MCP access is required.
payload.longDescription:
将您的Metadata账户连接至平台，即可创建可编辑的品牌广告方案，查询受众定位标准并预估覆盖范围，检查广告活动设置，并分析广告表现及销售漏斗归因。支持针对Facebook、Instagram、LinkedIn、Reddit、Google Ads和Microsoft Advertising的广告活动工作流，具体支持情况取决于您的已连接账户、权限及可用工具。在授权广告投放或调整实时预算前，可先审查拟议的修改方案。

需要已存在的Metadata账户且具备MCP访问权限。

payload.name: Flexport
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Flexport helps users search logistics reference data, track and browse shipments, review quote requests and pricing, request rates, and create freight bookings through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Flexport帮助用户搜索物流参考数据，跟踪和浏览货运信息，审核报价请求和定价，请求报价，并通过ChatGPT创建货运预订。

payload.name: AlterVision
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: AlterVision helps retail teams analyze visitor traffic, sales, conversion rates, and progress toward store and seller targets. Connect an existing account to find stores, compare daily performance, review sales competition standings, and investigate why visits did not become purchases through reason summaries and seller-recorded explanations. Non-conversion reports and sales competitions require AlterVez access.
payload.longDescription:
AlterVision帮助零售团队分析访客流量、销售数据、转化率以及达成店铺和卖家目标的进度。
连接现有账户可查找店铺，对比每日表现，查看销售竞争排名，并通过原因总结和卖家记录的解释，分析访问量未转化为购买的原因。
非转化报告和销售竞争数据需要AlterVez访问权限。

payload.name: Tassyir
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Tassyir is the back office of e-commerce merchants in Algeria. Once a merchant connects their Tassyir business, ChatGPT can review sales (orders, confirmation and delivery rates, delivered revenue, ad spend, best sellers and top wilayas), work the order queue (list pending orders, confirm, cancel, schedule, assign and comment on them, dispatch confirmed orders to delivery and follow parcels until delivered or returned), manage the catalog (create and update products with sizes, colors and per-variant prices, categories and stock levels) and keep the books (record expenses and capital transactions). Every action runs with the merchant’s own Tassyir role permissions, on the one business they connected. Amounts are in Algerian dinars (DZD).
payload.longDescription: Tassyir是阿尔及利亚电商商家的后台系统。商家连接其Tassyir账户后，ChatGPT可查看销售数据（订单、确认率与交付率、已交付营收、广告支出、畅销品和热门省区）、处理订单队列（列出待处理订单、进行确认/取消/调度/分配并添加备注、将确认订单分配给物流并追踪包裹直至交付或退回）、管理商品目录（创建和编辑商品，设置尺寸/颜色及各变体价格、分类和库存水平）以及财务记账（记录费用和资本交易）。所有操作均基于商家自身的Tassyir角色权限，在其已连接的单一业务账户下执行。金额单位为阿尔及利亚第纳尔（DZD）。

payload.name: Assembly
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Assembly helps users work with clients from ChatGPT. Users can find clients and companies, manage tasks, notes, files, messages, forms, contracts, invoices, subscriptions, products, prices, app connections, notifications, and related workspace activity and records through authenticated Assembly APIs.
payload.longDescription: Assembly帮助用户通过ChatGPT与客户协作。用户可以通过经过认证的Assembly API查找客户和公司，管理任务、笔记、文件、消息、表单、合同、发票、订阅、产品、价格、应用连接、通知以及相关工作区活动和记录。

payload.name: Hiver in Gmail
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect ChatGPT to your Hiver shared inboxes. Ask questions about the conversations your team handles in Gmail: search and read conversations, find the emails behind a Gmail thread, see who is on an inbox and which tags and SLA policies apply. Move work forward without leaving the chat: add internal notes visible only to your team, apply or remove tags, and save reply drafts for a teammate to review and send. Administrators can also pull inbox reports directly: conversation volume, response performance, SLA compliance, agent workload, CSAT, sentiment, and per-company support summaries. Every action uses your own Hiver account and permissions, so you only ever see the shared inboxes you are a member of, writes are attributed to you, and nothing is ever sent to a customer by the app itself.
payload.longDescription:
将ChatGPT连接到您的Hiver共享邮箱。
针对团队在Gmail中处理的对话提出问题：搜索并查看对话内容，查找Gmail线程背后的邮件，查看邮箱成员及适用的标签和SLA政策。
无需离开聊天界面即可推进工作：添加仅对您的团队可见的内部备注，应用或移除标签，并保存回复草稿供同事审核并发送。
管理员还可直接提取邮箱报告：对话量、响应表现、SLA合规情况、客服工作量、CSAT（客户满意度）、情感分析以及按公司划分的支持摘要。
所有操作均使用您的Hiver账户和权限，因此您只能看到自己所属的共享邮箱，撰写内容会归于您的账号，且应用本身永远不会向客户发送任何信息。

payload.name: Hyros
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Hyros tracks every ad click, lead, and sale, so you can see which campaigns, ads, and keywords actually produce revenue. This app brings that data into ChatGPT.

Ask in plain language and get answers from your live Hyros account:

• "Which Meta campaigns had the best ROAS last month?"
• "What were my best performing ads last month?"
• "Where did last week's revenue actually come from?"
• "Show me an overview of the last 7 days"

ChatGPT can pull attribution reports, spend and ROAS by campaign or ad set, lead and customer journeys, revenue and LTV breakdowns, and call and booking data, then chart it, summarize it or drop it into the doc you're already writing.

Built for media buyers, agencies, and growth teams who spend their days reconciling ad platform numbers against what actually hit the bank account.

Requires an active Hyros account. You connect with your Hyros login, and ChatGPT only sees data that account already has access to.
payload.longDescription:
Hyros会追踪每个广告点击、潜在客户和销售情况，让您清楚了解哪些广告系列、广告和关键词真正带来了收入。该应用将这些数据带入ChatGPT。

用自然语言提问，即可从您的实时Hyros账户获取答案：

• 「上个月哪些Meta广告系列的广告支出回报率最高？」
• 「上个月哪些广告表现最佳？」
• 「上周的收入实际来自哪里？」
• 「给我一个过去7天的概览」

payload.longDescription: Chat Estelar帮助授权用户查看选定经纪人/开发商的整体运营绩效，包括房源信息、潜在客户流程、预约情况以及活跃代理指标。

payload.name: HYPD.AI for Search Console
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
HYPD.AI Google Search Console brings data from authorized Search Console properties into ChatGPT, helping site owners, marketers, and SEO teams understand how their sites appear in Google Search.

Use it to:

• Diagnose why a site or URL is not showing on Google by reviewing index status, crawl and fetch state, robots access, sitemaps, canonicals, and mobile usability.

• Explain indexing issues such as Crawled – currently not indexed, Discovered – currently not indexed, duplicate canonicals, noindex, blocked pages, soft 404s, redirects, and server errors.

• Check sitemap processing, errors, warnings, download dates, and URL counts.

• Analyze keywords and rankings using clicks, impressions, CTR, and average position by query, page, country, device, date, or search appearance.

• Compare periods to find traffic gains and losses, CTR opportunities, ranking changes, and the queries driving each page.

• List connected properties and explore Search Console data conversationally through ChatGPT and MCP.

HYPD.AI is read-only. It cannot request indexing, submit sitemaps, add or verify properties, manage users, edit content, or change rankings. It analyzes connected properties, explains findings, and recommends next steps.
payload.longDescription:
HYPD.AI Google搜索控制台将已授权的搜索控制台数据导入ChatGPT，帮助网站所有者、营销人员和SEO团队了解其网站在Google搜索中的展示情况。

可用于：

• 通过检查索引状态、抓取和获取状态、机器人访问权限、站点地图、规范标签及移动可用性，诊断网站或URL未在Google展示的原因。

• 解释索引问题，例如「已抓取-当前未索引」、「已发现-当前未索引」、重复规范标签、noindex标记、被阻止页面、软404错误、重定向和服务器错误。

• 检查站点地图处理情况、错误警告、下载日期及URL数量。

• 通过查询、页面、国家、设备、日期或搜索展示位置，分析关键词和排名数据（包括点击量、展示量、点击率和平均排名）。

• 对比不同周期数据，发现流量增减情况、点击率优化机会、排名变化及驱动各页面流量的搜索关键词。

• 列出已连接的站点，并通过与ChatGPT和MCP的对话方式探索Search Console数据。

HYPD.AI 为只读模式，无法请求索引、提交站点地图、添加或验证站点、管理用户、编辑内容或更改排名。它会分析已连接的站点，解释分析结果并推荐下一步操作。

payload.name: Groas
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect Groas to explore your Google Ads accounts in ChatGPT. Review campaigns, keywords, search terms, daily performance, account audits, and the changes Groas has made. Ask questions about results and investigate opportunities to improve your campaigns. Account access follows your Groas login. Read access is the default; eligible subscribers can opt into permission to make changes. Authorized changes affect your connected Google Ads account and are recorded in Groas’s action history. A Groas account and connected Google Ads account are required for account analysis.
payload.longDescription: 将Groas连接至ChatGPT，以探索您的Google Ads账户。查看广告活动、关键词、搜索词、每日表现、账户审计及Groas所做的更改。针对结果提出问题并挖掘优化广告活动的机会。账户访问权限遵循您的Groas登录状态。默认为只读权限；符合条件的订阅者可选择开启修改权限。授权更改将影响您连接的Google Ads账户，并记录在Groas的操作历史中。进行账户分析需要Groas账户和已连接的Google Ads账户。

payload.name: Omneky
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Omneky helps signed-in users review brand performance, manage product catalogue data, create image and product-video assets, and launch or manage campaigns across the signed-in brand's connected advertising channels. It does not manage calendars or banking, access another advertiser's accounts, or administer application deployments or DNS.
payload.longDescription: Omneky为已登录用户提供帮助，可审查品牌表现、管理产品目录数据、创建图像和产品视频资产，并在已登录品牌连接的广告渠道上启动或管理活动。该工具不管理日历或银行账户，不访问其他广告商的账户，也不负责应用程序部署或DNS管理。

payload.name: Trend Seeker
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Trend Seeker helps founders and researchers find business problems backed by public market signals. Search or browse ideas, inspect the reasoning behind one idea, compare a shortlist, and open dated source evidence. Trend Seeker scores help prioritize further research. They are not forecasts, financial advice, or guarantees of demand.
payload.longDescription: Trend Seeker 帮助创始人和研究人员找到由公开市场信号支持的商业问题。搜索或浏览创意，查看某个创意的推理依据，对比候选列表，并查看带有日期的原始证据。Trend Seeker 的评分有助于优先进行进一步研究。它们不是预测、财务建议或需求保证。

payload.name: AWS Data Analytics
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Data lake, analytics, and ETL workflows with S3 Tables, AWS Glue, and Athena. Covers managed Iceberg tables on S3 Tables, ingestion from JDBC databases, Amazon Redshift, Snowflake, BigQuery, and DynamoDB, AWS Glue Data Catalog inventory and asset discovery, federated Athena queries, and vector storage and semantic search on Amazon S3 Vectors.
payload.longDescription: 使用 S3 Tables、AWS Glue 和 Athena 处理数据湖、分析和 ETL 工作流。涵盖 S3 Tables 上的托管 Iceberg 表，从 JDBC 数据库、Amazon Redshift、Snowflake、BigQuery 和 DynamoDB 摄取数据，AWS Glue Data Catalog 的目录清单及资产发现，Athena 联邦查询，以及 Amazon S3 Vectors 上的向量存储和语义搜索。

payload.name: ThoughtSpot Spotter
payload.description: 你的 AI 数据分析师
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: From everyday data questions to high-level strategic analyses, Spotter by ThoughtSpot helps business and data teams get answers and insights they can trust, validate, and act on, enabling everyone to use data to drive the business forward.
payload.longDescription: 从日常数据问题到高层战略分析，ThoughtSpot 的 Spotter 都能帮助业务和数据团队获取可信、可验证且可采取行动的答案与洞察，让每个人都能利用数据推动业务发展。

payload.name: Sigma
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Explore, search, query your data, and build applications and dashboards in Sigma directly from the ChatGPT interface. You can search across your organization for relevant documents and elements, answer and iterate on complex data questions, and perform detailed analysis using natural language.
payload.longDescription: 直接在 ChatGPT 界面中探索、搜索和查询数据，并在 Sigma 中构建应用和控制面板。你可以在组织内搜索相关文档和元素，回答并迭代复杂的数据问题，也可以使用自然语言进行详细分析。

payload.name: PostHog
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: PostHog gives your AI agent direct access to your product analytics, feature flags, experiments, error tracking, surveys, logs, and LLM analytics. Ask questions about your data, create insights, toggle feature flags, analyze errors, search docs, and more — all from chat.
payload.longDescription: PostHog 让您的 AI 智能体直接访问产品分析、功能开关、实验、错误跟踪、调查、日志和 LLM 分析。您可以询问数据、创建分析洞察、切换功能开关、分析错误、搜索文档等，所有操作都可在聊天中完成。

payload.name: Helium 10
payload.description: 访问你的 Helium 10 数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Access your Helium 10 data directly in ChatGPT for Amazon sellers and FBA brands. Query keyword and ASIN data, analyze PPC campaign performance and profitability, and extract insights from your listings and rank tracking.

Make Helium 10 a native part of your ChatGPT workflows without switching between dashboards or exporting files. Built for active e-commerce brands with real account data across Product Research, Ads, and Commerce.
payload.longDescription:
Amazon 卖家和 FBA 品牌可直接在 ChatGPT 中访问 Helium 10 数据。查询关键词和 ASIN 数据、分析 PPC 广告活动表现及盈利能力，并从商品列表和排名追踪中提取洞察。

无需在控制面板之间切换或导出文件，即可将 Helium 10 融入 ChatGPT 工作流程。专为拥有真实 Product Research、Ads 和 Commerce 账号数据的活跃电商品牌打造。

payload.name: Typeform
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Build forms, contact lists, and automations without leaving ChatGPT. Use natural language to analyze your form and survey data, create data-rich contact profiles, and build automations that turn your form respondents into customers. Typeform makes it easy to understand and act on your customer data—without switching tools.
payload.longDescription: 无需离开 ChatGPT，即可创建表单、联系人列表和自动化流程。使用自然语言分析表单和问卷数据、创建包含丰富信息的联系人档案，并构建将表单答卷者转化为客户的自动化流程。Typeform 让你无需切换工具，即可轻松理解并使用客户数据。

payload.name: Amplitude
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect your Amplitude workspace to search charts and dashboards, query metrics and experiment results, explore events and properties, and create or update charts, dashboards, and alerts — without leaving the conversation. Amplitude is the product intelligence platform teams use to understand user behavior, measure impact, and decide what to build next.
payload.longDescription: 连接 Amplitude 工作区，搜索图表和控制面板，查询指标和实验结果，探索事件及属性，并创建或更新图表、控制面板和告警，无需离开对话。Amplitude 是团队用来了解用户行为、衡量影响并决定下一步构建什么的产品智能平台。

payload.name: Blockscout Blockchain Data
payload.description: 查找并分析区块链数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Query live blockchain data across 90+ EVM-compatible blockchain networks directly in ChatGPT. Blockscout gives you instant access to wallet balances, transaction histories, token holdings, NFTs, smart contract source code, and contract ABIs, no API keys required.

Ask questions in plain English: "What tokens does this wallet hold?", "Show me recent transactions on this contract", or "Resolve this ENS name." Blockscout handles the lookup and returns structured, accurate on-chain data in seconds.
payload.longDescription:
直接在ChatGPT中查询90+个兼容EVM的区块链网络的实时数据。Blockscout让你即时获取钱包余额、交易历史、代币持仓、NFT、智能合约源代码和合约ABI，无需API密钥。

用日常英语提问：“这个钱包持有哪些代币？”“显示这个合约的近期交易”，或“解析这个ENS名称。”Blockscout负责查询，并在几秒内返回结构化、准确的链上数据。

payload.name: Mixpanel
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Query and analyze your Mixpanel data directly in ChatGPT. Run segmentation, funnel, and retention analyses, explore your event taxonomy, manage Lexicon metadata, and resolve data quality issues - all without leaving your conversation.

With the Mixpanel MCP server connected, ChatGPT can reason about your product analytics alongside your code, documents, and decisions. Ask questions in plain language, drill into user behavior, and get answers grounded in your actual data.
payload.longDescription:
直接在 ChatGPT 中查询和分析你的 Mixpanel 数据。运行细分、漏斗和留存分析，探索事件分类，管理 Lexicon 元数据，并解决数据质量问题，全程无需离开对话。

连接 Mixpanel MCP 服务器后，ChatGPT 可以结合代码、文档和决策来推理产品分析。用自然语言提问、深入了解用户行为，并获得基于真实数据的答案。

payload.name: Waldo
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Waldo helps users research brands, advertising, social conversations, trends, and captured workspace intelligence by combining specialized skills with external data and authenticated workspace context.
payload.longDescription: Waldo 结合专业技能、外部数据和经过身份验证的工作区上下文，帮助用户研究品牌、广告、社交讨论、趋势以及已捕获的工作区情报。

payload.name: Serpstat
payload.description: SEO 数据与关键词研究
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Build semantic keyword clusters, discover untapped market niches from 1000+ categories, and conduct comprehensive competitor analysis. Examine rival SEO strategies through their keyword portfolios, backlink profiles, top-performing pages, and ranking dynamics. Track domain positions across regions, audit technical site issues, identify content gaps, and evaluate keyword opportunities with volume and difficulty metrics. Claude navigates these capabilities naturally — combining data from multiple sources, validating SEO hypotheses in real-time, and building comprehensive strategies through interactive dialogue.
payload.longDescription: 构建语义关键词集群，从 1000+ 个类别中发现尚未开发的细分市场，并全面分析竞争对手。通过竞争对手的关键词组合、反向链接资料、表现最佳页面和排名动态，研究其 SEO 策略。追踪各地区的域名搜索排名位置、审核网站技术问题、发现内容差距，并根据搜索量和难度指标评估关键词机会。Claude 可以自然地运用这些功能，将多个数据源结合起来、实时验证 SEO 假设，并通过互动对话制定全面策略。

payload.name: BlazeSQL
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
BlazeSQL lets ChatGPT and Codex query your database or warehouse with all the necessary context to get the correct answers.

Connect to Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, AWS Athena, MariaDB, SQL Anywhere, Databricks, Clickhouse, and Oracle.

With context management, observability, and comprehensive access controls, BlazeSQL turns ChatGPT or Codex into an enterprise-ready AI Data Analyst for reliable self-service across your entire company.

As a comprehensive Business Intelligence layer, BlazeSQL also enables visualization, dashboards, advanced statistical analysis, predictive analytics, scheduled reports, and custom PDF or interactive HTML reports.
payload.longDescription:
BlazeSQL 让 ChatGPT 和 Codex 查询你的数据库或数据仓库，并提供获得正确答案所需的全部上下文。

连接 Snowflake、BigQuery、Redshift、Microsoft SQL Server、PostgreSQL、MySQL、AWS Athena、MariaDB、SQL Anywhere、Databricks、Clickhouse 和 Oracle。

借助上下文管理、可观测性和全面的访问控制，BlazeSQL 将 ChatGPT 或 Codex 转变为满足企业要求的 AI 数据分析师，在整个公司范围内提供可靠的自助服务。

作为全面的商业智能层，BlazeSQL 还支持可视化、控制面板、高级统计分析、预测分析、定期报告，以及自定义 PDF 或交互式 HTML 报告。

payload.name: Tableau (MCP only; EOL soon)
payload.description: Tableau（仅 MCP；即将结束生命周期）
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: This MCP based plugin will be deprecated shortly, please switch usage to the new Tableau Plugin.
payload.longDescription: 此基于 MCP 的插件即将停用，请改用新的 Tableau Plugin。

payload.name: Hex
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Answer data questions and spin up new analyses with the Hex Agent.
payload.longDescription: 使用 Hex Agent 解答数据问题，并开展新的分析。

payload.name: Trellis Law
payload.description: 美国州级初审法院研究
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Direct access to the US state trial court system, enabling legal research and insights on cases, verdicts, judges, attorneys, motions, litigation trends, and more - all grounded and sourced from trial court data and documents.
payload.longDescription: 直接访问美国州级初审法院系统，开展法律研究并获取有关案件、裁决、法官、律师、动议、诉讼趋势等方面的洞见；所有内容均以初审法院数据和文件为依据并附有来源。

payload.name: CData Connect AI
payload.description: 无需查询即可获得答案
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect AI works with cloud data warehouses, relational databases, data lakehouses, analytics platforms and more so you can explore and analyze your data through conversation. Use your data as input to the work you're doing in ChatGPT, like correlating product telemetry with the release schedule to investigate user engagement. In Connect AI, you build virtual datasets across sources with defined relationships and semantic context, and surface them as purpose-built tools – so ChatGPT works with your data the way your business understands it, not just the way it’s stored. IT admins control access and monitor every query with full audit trails — so the right people reach the right data, nothing more.
payload.longDescription: Connect AI 可连接云数据仓库、关系数据库、数据湖仓、分析平台等，让您通过对话探索和分析数据。将数据用于 ChatGPT 中的工作，例如关联产品遥测与发布日程以调查用户参与度。在 Connect AI 中，您可以跨来源构建具有明确关系和语义上下文的虚拟数据集，并将其呈现为专用工具，让 ChatGPT 按企业理解数据的方式工作，而不只是按数据存储方式工作。IT 管理员控制访问权限，并通过完整审计跟踪监控每次查询，确保合适的人访问合适的数据。

payload.name: MotherDuck
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect AI assistants to your MotherDuck data warehouse. Explore, visualize, and manage data using natural language–no SQL skills required. Create Dives: interactive visualizations that let you save and share answers with your team, staying up-to-date with your latest data. Works with real-world data without requiring semantic models or pre-configuration. Your AI assistant acts like a data analyst, exploring, validating, analyzing, and visualizing data iteratively to answer your questions.
payload.longDescription: 将 AI 助手连接到 MotherDuck 数据仓库。使用自然语言浏览、可视化和管理数据，无需 SQL 技能。创建 Dives：可交互的可视化内容，让你保存并与团队共享答案，同时保持最新数据同步。无需语义模型或预配置，即可处理真实世界的数据。你的 AI 助手会像数据分析师一样迭代探索、验证、分析和可视化数据，从而回答问题。

payload.name: StatsHawk
payload.description: 体育数据、球员道具投注与对阵分析
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
StatsHawk gives ChatGPT real, current sports data instead of guesses from training data. Ask about any game and get scores, schedules, standings, box scores, rosters, and player lookups across NBA, WNBA, MLB, NFL, NHL, KBO, NCAA basketball and football, and major soccer competitions including the Premier League, all normalized into one consistent shape, with numbers landing within minutes of box scores posting.

Beyond the basics: MLB pitch-by-pitch with Statcast detail (pitch type, velocity, launch data, filterable to a batter-pitcher matchup) and pre-computed player prop analysis, season, recent, and home/away averages with hit rates against any line, built for fantasy research, start/sit calls, and matchup prep.

Sign in with a free StatsHawk account when you connect; no API key to manage. Free includes 5,000 usage credits monthly and every standard stat tool. Prop analysis comes with paid plans.
payload.longDescription:
StatsHawk 为 ChatGPT 提供真实、最新的体育数据，而不是训练数据中的猜测。你可以询问任意比赛，并获取比分、赛程、排名、比赛数据表、球队名单和球员查询，覆盖 NBA、WNBA、MLB、NFL、NHL、KBO、NCAA 篮球和橄榄球，以及包括 Premier League 在内的主要足球赛事。所有数据都经过统一规范，更新时间距离比赛数据表发布仅几分钟。

除基础功能外，还包括 MLB 逐球数据及 Statcast 详情（球种、球速、击球初速和角度数据，可按击球手与投手对阵筛选），以及预先计算的球员道具投注分析、赛季/近期/主客场平均值和针对任意盘口的命中率，适合幻想体育研究、先发/替补选择和对阵准备。

连接时使用免费的 StatsHawk 账户登录；无需管理 API 密钥。免费账户每月包含 5,000 个使用积分和所有标准统计工具。球员道具分析需使用付费套餐。

payload.name: GIS Cloud
payload.description: 创建地图并进行 GIS 分析
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
GIS Cloud is a cloud geospatial platform used by governments, utilities, and field teams in 60+ countries. 

This app lets you work with your GIS Cloud account in plain language, no GIS expertise or clicking through menus required.

Ask ChatGPT to build and edit maps, create and style layers, add or query features, run spatial analysis, design mobile data collection forms for field teams, import datasets, and generate reports. It covers the full GIS workflow, from field capture to mapping, analysis, and reporting.

What you can do:
- Create, update, and organize maps and layers
- Add, edit, and query features and attribute data
- Run spatial analysis and compute statistics on your data
- Build and manage Mobile Data Collection forms for field teams
- Import files and manage datasets
- Generate reports from your geospatial data

You stay in control. GIS Cloud uses a propose-and-confirm model: changes are proposed before anything is written to your account, and destructive actions are clearly flagged. Access is scoped to your account through secure OAuth, with read-only operations separated from writes.

Works with your existing GIS Cloud account. New to GIS Cloud? Sign up free at giscloud.com.
payload.longDescription:
GIS Cloud 是一款云端地理空间平台，供 60 多个国家的政府、公用事业单位和外勤团队使用。

此应用让你可以用日常语言操作自己的 GIS Cloud 账户，无需 GIS 专业知识，也不必在菜单中反复点击。

让 ChatGPT 创建和编辑地图、创建并设置图层样式、添加或查询要素、运行空间分析、为外勤团队设计移动数据采集表单、导入数据集并生成报告。它覆盖完整 GIS 工作流程，从外勤采集到制图、分析和报告。

你可以：
- 创建、更新和整理地图及图层
- 添加、编辑和查询要素及属性数据
- 对数据运行空间分析并计算统计数据
- 为外勤团队创建和管理移动数据采集表单
- 导入文件并管理数据集
- 根据地理空间数据生成报告

由你掌控操作。GIS Cloud 采用“提出并确认”模式：在写入账户前会先提出变更，并明确标记具有破坏性的操作。访问权限通过安全的 OAuth 限定在你的账户范围内，只读操作与写入操作相互区分。

可与现有 GIS Cloud 账户配合使用。还没有 GIS Cloud 账户？可在 giscloud.com 免费注册。

payload.name: Powerset Research
payload.description: 访问 Powerset Research 数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Powerset Research (https://research.powerset.co/) is a technical journal from Powerset (https://powerset.co/) where we analyze tech trends, publish analytics, and provide free tools for helping founders. This app allows anyone to access the data underlying Powerset Research via ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Powerset Research（https://research.powerset.co/）是 Powerset（https://powerset.co/）的技术期刊，分析科技趋势、发布分析报告，并提供帮助创业者的免费工具。此应用让任何人都能通过 ChatGPT 访问 Powerset Research 的底层数据。

payload.name: Similarweb
payload.description: 网站、应用、搜索和市场数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Research any website or app inside ChatGPT using Similarweb's market intelligence data. Analyze competitor traffic, uncover top keywords, explore audience demographics, and benchmark performance across industries—all through simple prompts.
